name: openhuman
description: OpenHuman (a Rust desktop agent): when `openhuman-core` is on PATH and this is on, LOKI connects to its MCP server (openhuman-core mcp, stdio JSON-RPC).
license: GPL-3.0 (separate program; no OpenHuman code is in LOKI)
install: Install OpenHuman from its GitHub releases so `openhuman-core` is on PATH (python tools/setup_extras.py openhuman shows how)
